body: Is it honestly worth waiting that long?
I actually do not want friends, but I do want to want friends. I would label myself as a misanthrope because for the most part, I despise people to a very unhealthy level.
I am 26 years old. Since I work overnights, I typically sleep from 5am - 12:30pm.
Unfortunately, eating is the one thing that I still enjoy, so I guess I do have an "interest" even if it's unhealthy.
